exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.formNote: Brace hard and keep the bar over mid-foot.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.formNote: Elbows high and torso upright through the rep.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.formNote: Sit between your hips with the bell tight to your chest.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat
exercises.formNote: Keep the bar cradled tight without letting it roll.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.formNote: Sit back to the box without relaxing your brace.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.formNote: Track knees over toes and control the descent.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.formNote: Lower until depth is comfortable without butt wink.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.formNote: Extend without kicking hips off the pad.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.formNote: Lean back as knees travel forward under control.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.formNote: Keep front shin mostly vertical and torso tall.

exercises.name: Forward Lunge
exercises.formNote: Step long enough to keep front knee stable.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.formNote: Take balanced steps and avoid wobble at the bottom.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.formNote: Drive through the whole foot on the box.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.formNote: Counterbalance and control the descent on one leg.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.formNote: Pull slack out and keep the bar close to your legs.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.formNote: Push hips back until you feel a hamstring stretch.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.formNote: Spread the floor and keep shoulders over the bar.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.formNote: Drive through the floor with a tall chest.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.formNote: Hinge on one leg with a straight line from head to heel.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.formNote: Hinge with a soft knee and neutral spine.

exercises.name: Jefferson Curl
exercises.formNote: Round slowly segment by segment on light loads only.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.formNote: Lower under control using hands only as needed.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.formNote: Keep hips extended and control the eccentric.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.formNote: Curl without lifting hips off the pad.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.formNote: Retract shoulder blades and press in a slight arc.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
exercises.formNote: Set a moderate incline and touch upper chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.formNote: Press with wrists stacked over elbows.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.formNote: Keep elbows tucked and wrists straight.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.formNote: Maintain a straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.formNote: Slight bend in elbows and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.formNote: Brace glutes and press the bar in a straight line.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.formNote: Dip straight and drive the bar with legs then arms.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.formNote: Lead with elbows and stop around shoulder height.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.formNote: Hinge and pull apart with rear delts doing the work.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.formNote: Pull to the face with external rotation at the end.

exercises.name: Shrug
exercises.formNote: Shrug straight up without rolling shoulders.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.formNote: Hinge and pull to the lower ribs.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.formNote: Reset each rep on the floor with a flat back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.formNote: Pull elbow to hip without twisting excessively.

exercises.name: Seal Row
exercises.formNote: Pull without using momentum from hips.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.formNote: Drive elbows down and avoid leaning back excessively.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.formNote: Start from a dead hang and pull chest toward the bar.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.formNote: Keep chin over the bar without craning neck.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.formNote: Lean slightly forward for chest or upright for triceps.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.formNote: Lock elbows at sides and fully extend.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.formNote: Lower to forehead or behind head with stable upper arms.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.formNote: Keep elbows fixed and curl without swinging.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.formNote: Neutral grip throughout the rep.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.formNote: Do not hyperextend at the bottom.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.formNote: Stand tall and take short quick steps.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.formNote: Tuck pelvis and drive through heels at the top.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.formNote: Squeeze glute without arching lower back.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.formNote: Pause at the top and control the descent.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.formNote: Ribs down and glutes engaged for a straight line.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.formNote: Posterior pelvic tilt before lifting legs.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.formNote: Crunch ribs toward hips without pulling with arms.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.formNote: Brace and roll only as far as you can control.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.formNote: Resist rotation and hold the band in front of chest.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.formNote: Hinge explosively and snap hips; arms are hooks.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-up
exercises.formNote: Eyes on the bell and move through each position deliberately.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.formNote: Extend hips and catch in a strong front rack.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.formNote: Land softly with hips back on the box.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.formNote: Drive through balls of feet with torso angled.

exercises.name: Band Pull-apart
exercises.formNote: Pull band apart to rear delts with straight arms.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.formNote: Squeeze glutes at the top without hyperextending.
